solo.replyFailed: Could not get a reply. Please send a message again shortly.
solo.moodPlaceholder: Kept here so you can look back later
solo.restBody: We've talked for a while. A glass of water sounds nice. I'll be right here
solo.lateNightBody: It's late. We can pick this up tomorrow
samples: I feel so lonely and exhausted today
haha that was awesome, love it
I'm so nervous about tomorrow's interview
I'm so angry, this is annoying

down: Rough day. You don't have to explain. Just sit here.
Some days are like that. Take your time. I'm listening.
up: Good. Haven't seen that face in a while.
Glad to hear it. That's good.
neutral: You're here. Sit down. How was today?

down: It's not that you're lacking; the world just has no eye. Tell me slowly.
Today I shall do the listening. Consider it an honor… kidding. What happened?
up: As expected of someone I noticed. Keep that mood going.
I like that look. You could ride it all day, couldn't you?
neutral: Standing before me again, I see. So, what's going on?

down: Tonight's story… mm, not an easy day. Tell me a little more.
You can leave that feeling here. Let's sort through it slowly.
up: What a nice story. On a day like this I'd play something bright for you.
Why not keep that feeling as today's one line?
neutral: Welcome to the late-night show. Tell me about your day.
Mm, let me put it this way. Could you tell me a bit more?

down: Okay. What's blocking you? One thing at a time.
I get that it's hard. Split it in three. Start with the first.
up: Oh, nice. You actually pulled it off.
Good. Keep that momentum for the next one.
